description: Without signing in: the whole session schedule, the public stream link while a session is live (from 30 minutes before the start to 10 minutes after the end), and YouTube and Vimeo recordings; never the members' join link. Signed in with a free QuantGeeks account: the same. With a QuantGeeks plan: the members' join link in place of the stream link, and every recording. Upcoming and live QuantGeeks team sessions with start and end times in US Eastern and canceled sessions marked canceled; the join link (members) or the public live-stream link (preview) only while the join window is open (from 30 minutes before the start to 10 minutes after the end); and recorded past sessions with their recording links, newest first (at most 20; `detail` 'all' lifts the cap). A session passcode is shown only on the QuantGeeks desk.
name: quantgeeks_get_webinar_schedule
title: Webinar schedule and recordings
